messages:
Marta: Quick UI QA: FAB overlaps toasts on the dashboard when 2+ notifications show. Screenshot attached. Can we adjust spacing or anchor?
Liam: Yep saw that. Happens with compact grid rows + bottom-right toasts. FAB z-index sits above toasts.
Devin: Token issue or layout priority? We reduced row spacing to 8px for density.
Marta: Both. Toasts use token space-xs (8px) and FAB maintains 16px from edge. On short heights they collide.
Claire: Options: 1) Increase bottom toast offset when FAB present, 2) Anchor toasts bottom-left on dashboards, 3) Shrink FAB hit area but keep visual size (a11y risk).
Marta: Leaning to #1. Left toasts might clash with list actions.
Liam: Add a `toast-offset-bottom` token that composes with `fab-edge-gap`. Allows per-layout opt-in.
Devin: Proposal: default `toast-offset-bottom: 24px` if `fab-present=true` (current default 16px). Covers most small viewports.
Claire: Ensure entrance animation respects offset so toasts don't animate under FAB. Also screen readers: toasts must remain aria-live even if visually moved.
Marta: Also saw toasts that are icons-only with no aria-label. Need copy guidance: short text prefix for SRs, e.g., `aria-label=\"Success: config saved\"`.
design-bot: Suggested token change: `toast-offset-bottom: 24` and `fab-edge-gap: 16`. Recommend CSS var fallback `--toast-offset-bottom: calc(var(--fab-edge-gap, 16px) + 8px)`.
Liam: Suggest runtime detection via `data-fab='true'` on body so toast system computes offset at render instead of hardcoding per page.
Devin: Fine, but provide CSS var fallback for older integrations. Also add regression test where compact grid doesn't reflow when toast height increases.
Claire: Copy/update in docs: show examples for screen reader labels and animation guidelines.
Marta: I'll open a small PR with token bump + demo page. Can someone review a11y examples?
Liam: I'll review. Checklist: visual overlap fixed, animation not clipped, focus behavior sane, SR reads full message.
Devin: I'll add the layout regression test to the console test matrix.
Marta: Thanks everyone \":thumbsup:\"
